svg.text: In-feed guard: 920 x 92 mm, 50 mm in front of the pinch line; its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lower edge 8 mm above the in-feed table, rolled to a 4 mm radius.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Out-feed guard: 920 x 79 mm, 150 mm behind the pinch line, lower

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge 8 mm above the out-feed table.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: 920 x 204 mm, joining the two guards over the rolls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain guard: a box 30 x 355 x 180 mm round both sprockets, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes for the shafts; bolted to the crank bracket housing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gear guard: a box 65 x 90 x 145 mm over the pinch gears, bolted

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All guards held by M6 screws: a tool is needed to take them off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 10 mm rod cannot reach any nip, gear or sprocket.
